summary: Greater Tunis meets the sea across the Gulf of Tunis. La Goulette, on the sandbar between Lake Tunis and the gulf, is the city's ferry and cruise gateway; a short crossing north lies Sidi Bou Said, whose marina is cut into the cliff below the blue-and-white village, and beyond it the Gammarth and La Marsa beach resorts. These waterfront points sit minutes apart by sea but are linked today only by a slow coastal road, making the bay a natural short-hop water network for the capital.
